title: Trump’s 25% Tariffs Reshape Tech Supply Chains
excerpt: President Trump’s new 25% tariffs on $400 billion in imports from 60 trade partners directly impact technology supply chains. Tech professionals face rising hardware costs, a pressing need for diversification, and a fundamentally altered global trade landscape.
description: President Trump’s 25% tariffs on $400B in imports from 60 nations disrupt tech supply chains, raising hardware costs and forcing diversification.
